newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Yilmaz to visit Germany in September.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Yilmaz to visit Germany in September.

text.p: Turkey's Prime Minister Mesut Yilmaz plans to visit Germany in September on his first official trip abroad since taking office last month, a Turkish foreign ministry official said on Thursday.
He said the visit would likely take place on September 30.
Conservative Yilmaz came to power after Islamist Necmettin Erbakan's government collapsed in June under intense secularist pressure amid a row over religous activism.
Visits by Erbakan to Iran and Libya during his one-year tenure upset some of Turkey's NATO allies who say the two countries have supported anti-Western bomb attacks.
Yilmaz, who speaks fluent German, heads a secularist coalition of three conservative and left-wing parties.
